text:
Pharma Careers
Boston University’s Metropolitan College offers a variety of programs and resources for students. We are interested in proposing data analytics programs to help students develop skills in Pharma Data Analytics Careers (Pesqueira and Sousa 2024).





References

Pesqueira, Antonio, and Maria José Sousa. 2024. “Exploring the Role of Big Data Analytics and Dynamic Capabilities in ESG Programs Within Pharmaceuticals.” Software Quality Journal 32 (2): 607–40.
